subject.title: chore: cover queued session rotation regression

question: Should this test-only PR require a real-provider queued `/new` Gateway run, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gate for its isolated real-Gateway/mock-model evidence?
rationale: The patch changes only regression coverage and reports strong before-and-after Testbox results, but repository policy says tests and mocks are supplemental rather than sufficient real-behavior proof for an external PR.

options.title: Require real-provider proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal or runtime logs showing an active real-provider turn followed by queued `/new` reaching the replacement model invocation.

options.title: Override for test-only scope
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the isolated real-Gateway evidence because the PR changes no runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Require real-provider proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal or runtime logs showing an active real-provider turn followed by queued `/new` reaching the replacement model invocation.

likelyOwner.reason: The underlying queued-turn lifecycle implementation and its previous land-ready proof were owned and merged through this person's history.
